333 days is 365 - 32 days, so it's less than a full year.  
04-04-1009 + 333 days:  
April has 30 days, so from Apr 4 to May 4 is 30 days, to Jun 4 is 61 days, to Jul 4 is 91 days, to Aug 4 is 122 days, to Sep 4 is 153 days, to Oct 4 is 183 days, to Nov 4 is 214 days, to Dec 4 is 244 days.  
333 - 244 = 89 days left after Dec 4.  
December has 31 days, so Dec 4 to Jan 4 is 31 days, to Feb 4 is 31+31=62 days, to Mar 4 is 62+28=90 days in 1010 (not leap year, since 1010 not divisible by 4).  
We need 89 days after Dec 4: 31 days to Jan 4, 62 days to Feb 4, 90 days to Mar 4 — too many. So stop at Feb 4 (62 days), remaining 89-62=27 days into March.  
Feb 4 + 27 days = Mar 3 (since Feb has 28 days in 1010).  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1010-03-03
